verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS code-review service like Bugbot, but the evidence pack documents no feature for exporting user data in open formats. The account-deletion note covers leaving, not exporting. Review findings live as PR comments on the host Git platform, and BUGBOT.md rule files sit in the user's own repository; both are host-platform or user-side arrangements, not a product export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
